works.title: AI-Assisted Writing Framework
works.description: Systematic methodology for standardized AI-assisted fiction writing, extracting and organizing prompts into reusable framework documents with master outline-centric architecture and defined production phases.
works.quote: I want to extract prompts from my writing process to standardize and organize them.

works.title: Parliament of Self Model
works.description: Narrative/mythological model of consciousness structured as a parliamentary chamber with distinct political roles, visual symbolic elements (glowing God-seat, fog system), and architecture for storytelling presentation of how consciousness emerges and governs.
works.quote: For the book, you've basically already got a working mythology. We just need to nail the cast and the stage, then decide how to show it in story form.
